newsitem.title: USA: Envirodyne says ISS opposes Zapata rights proposal.
newsitem.headline: Envirodyne says ISS opposes Zapata rights proposal.

text.p: Envirodyne Industries Inc said Institutional Shareholder Services recommended that its clients vote for Envirodyne's slate of directors and against Zapata Corp's proposal to remove a stockholder rights plan at the company's annual meeting set for May 16.
ISS is an independent advisor on proxy contests, corporate governance and related issues, Envirodyne said.

In recommending a vote against the Zapata non-binding proposal to remove Envirodyne's stockholder rights plan, ISS said that it generally opposes such plans, but that Envirodyne's plan is "warranted in this case given the company's specific circumstances," according to Envirodyne.

Envirodyne said that ISS stated: "We agree with management in that it appears that Zapata's primary reason for engaging in a proxy contest with Envirodyne is to allow Zapata to gain majority control of the company without having to make a takeover offer for the whole company."
Envirodyne is in the food packaging and the food supplies industry. It reported 1996 operating income of $39.7 million on net sales of $651.4 million.
